# Fix DRG / thoracic ganglion classification (issue #3475)

## Summary

Addresses obophenotype/uberon#3475, which reported that:
- The thoracic dorsal root ganglion (UBERON:0002835) was incorrectly classified as a subclass of "thoracic ganglion" (UBERON:0000961). Dorsal root ganglia are sensory ganglia, not paravertebral/sympathetic ganglia.
- The label "thoracic ganglion" on UBERON:0000961 was ambiguous because the term is logically defined as a paravertebral ganglion, but "thoracic ganglion" in common usage can refer to any ganglion within the thorax (spinal/DRG, prevertebral, or paravertebral).

## Changes

### UBERON:0000961 — renamed to "thoracic paravertebral ganglion"
- `name` changed from `thoracic ganglion` to `thoracic paravertebral ganglion`. The new name matches the logical definition already present (`intersection_of: UBERON:0001807 ! paravertebral ganglion`, `intersection_of: part_of UBERON:0004863 ! thoracic sympathetic nerve trunk`).
- The synonym `thoracic paravertebral ganglion` [MA:0001159] is now the primary label, so that synonym entry was removed.
- The previously EXACT synonyms `thoracic ganglion`, `ganglion of thorax`, and `thorax ganglion` were demoted to RELATED. They refer to a broader/ambiguous concept and are not strictly exact equivalents of "thoracic paravertebral ganglion".
- `thoracic splanchnic ganglion`, `thoracic sympathetic ganglion`, and `ganglion thoracicum splanchnicum` are retained as EXACT synonyms.
- Added a `comment` documenting the rename rationale.
- Added `term_tracker_item` pointing to the issue.

### UBERON:0002835 — thoracic dorsal root ganglion
- Removed `is_a: UBERON:0000961` (which was the asserted parent "thoracic ganglion", now "thoracic paravertebral ganglion"). A dorsal root ganglion is sensory, not sympathetic/paravertebral.
- The existing logical definition (`intersection_of: UBERON:0000044 ! dorsal root ganglion`, `intersection_of: extends_fibers_into UBERON:0009630 ! root of thoracic nerve`) is sufficient to keep the term correctly classified — the reasoner will infer the most specific `is_a` parent (`dorsal root ganglion` → `sensory ganglion`).
- Added a `comment` documenting the change.
- Added `term_tracker_item` pointing to the issue.

## Checks performed

- Confirmed UBERON:0000961 has no other `is_a` children in `uberon-edit.obo` — only UBERON:0002835 referenced it as a parent. Removing that single is_a clears the bad parentage.
- Confirmed UBERON:0000044 (dorsal root ganglion) `is_a` UBERON:0001800 (sensory ganglion), so the reasoner will place UBERON:0002835 under the correct sensory-ganglion branch after this change.
- Validated the OBO file syntactically with `fastobo-validator` after editing — completed parsing/validation with no errors.
- Used `obo-checkout.pl` / `obo-checkin.pl` per the curator workflow.

## Notes for reviewers

- I did not modify the children of UBERON:0002835 (the segment-specific thoracic DRGs T1–T12). They continue to be classified under thoracic dorsal root ganglion, which itself is now correctly under dorsal root ganglion via the logical definition.
- I considered keeping `thoracic ganglion` as an EXACT synonym but decided against it: the rename was specifically motivated by the fact that "thoracic ganglion" is a broader/ambiguous concept than the paravertebral subset. RELATED is the more accurate scope.
- Signed: @dragon-ai-agent
